summary:
Blue Ember is a science-focused, hypothesis-driven chat dashboard for microgravity combustion and fire-safety research. It integrates and normalizes NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI/GEODE) combustion investigations and ranks them for mission environments (ISS, Moon, Mars) and user profiles (Ship Engineer, Researcher, Student).

Given a natural-language hypothesis, Blue Ember returns explainable, evidence-based results using C1–C5 scientific criteria (proximity to target conditions, MOC margin, flame-spread kinetics, thermal severity, toxicity), along with evidence strength, knowledge-gap analysis (including partial-gravity/lunar-relevant warnings), and traceable PSI/DOI sources. Results are exportable as CSV/JSON.

Built with React + TypeScript (Vite) and an ASP.NET Core 8 API, Blue Ember synthesizes dispersed microgravity combustion data into actionable fire-safety insights for future Moon and Mars missions.
details: Scientific problemUnderstanding how flames ignite, spread, and extinguish in microgravity and reduced-gravity environments is critical for fire safety as humans return to the Moon and travel to Mars. NASA has produced decades of microgravity combustion experiments, but the results are dispersed and hard to compare across conditions.What Blue Ember doesBlue Ember is a science-focused, hypothesis-driven chat dashboard that helps users explore NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI/GEODE) combustion and fire-safety investigations. Given a natural-language hypothesis, mission environment (ISS, Moon, Mars), and user profile (Ship Engineer, Researcher, Student), it returns ranked, explainable evidence to support decision-making.How it works (methods & data)- Data: Normalized NASA PSI/GEODE combustion investigations (~133 records, featured fire-safety subset) with traceable links to PSI/DOI.- Scoring: Each investigation is evaluated with explainable criteria C1–C5 — C1 proximity to target conditions, C2 margin to Minimum Oxygen Concentration (MOC), C3 flame-spread kinetics, C4 thermal severity (HRR), C5 toxicity (e.g., CO). Weighted score: S = w1·C1 + w2·C2 + w3·C3 + w4·C4 + w5·C5, adapted by profile and environment.- Analysis outputs: Ranked investigations, evidence strength, knowledge-gap/coverage analysis (including partial-gravity warnings relevant to lunar conditions), and CSV/JSON export.Impact for explorationBy synthesizing and interpreting microgravity combustion science, Blue Ember turns scattered experimental findings into actionable, evidence-based fire-safety insights for spacecraft and future lunar/Martian habitats.Tools & stackReact + TypeScript + Vite (frontend chat UI, EN/PT), ASP.NET Core 8 Minimal API (Vertical Slice), JSON cache with NASA PSI/GEODE integration, Swagger, Vitest. Optional NVIDIA endpoint for narrative responses.
